{{Top|ffa}} {{Otheruses|Faro|more=Argus (disambiguation)}} {{Character |type=CIS |image=[[File:Argyus_CoD.jpg]] |name=Faro Argyus |homeworld=[[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' |birth= |death=[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' a [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Rodia)/Legends|Republic frigate]]{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}} |species=[[Human/Legends|Human]] |gender=[[Gender/Legends|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height=1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]{{DB|character|argyus|Argyus, Captain}} |mass= |hair=Blond |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]''[[The Clone Wars: Agenda]]'' **[[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]] *[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Sometimes being a good soldier means doing what you think is right.|Faro Argyus|audio=ArgyusGoodSoldier.flac|}} '''Faro Argyus''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]], an elite branch of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Coming from a [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] family noted for its honor and loyalty, Argyus was a fifth-generation guard normally stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, after [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] managed to [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|capture]] [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], Argyus was assigned to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] and tasked with escorting the captured [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] to Coruscant alongside [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Unbeknownst to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], Argyus had been bribed by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|rescue]] Gunray from his [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] and return him to the Confederacy. Argyus was successful in this task, and he escaped with Gunray in a Republic [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Rodia)/Legends|''Consular''-class frigate]]. While aboard, the former Senate Commando boasted to Dooku's [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] that his mission had been successful—thereby taking all credit away from Ventress—and that he would report on it to Dooku. Ventress [[Shiak|drove]] one of her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] into the back of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] seat and through Argyus's [[Heart/Legends|heart]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. ==Biography== ===Republic service=== {{Quote|Captain Argyus will keep a watchful eye on your prisoner…|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, to Senator Padmé Amidala|''[[The Clone Wars: Transfer]]''}} Faro Argyus,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]'' a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was a member of the [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]] branch of the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]]. Members of his family—a [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] bloodline noted for its prestige and honor—had served the Senate as guards for five generations. Several years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], while Argyus was a young recruit just beginning his service as a Senate Guard, he encountered [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. He was assigned to guard a diplomatic envoy that included Dooku among its members. After negotiations had failed, the consular ship came under an attack, and during the fighting Argyus was gravely wounded. Only timely action by Dooku saved him, after which Argyus and Dooku became friends and associates. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Argyus became a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the Senate Guard. When Dooku left the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], he contacted Argyus and persuaded his friend to work for him in secret. Captain Argyus continued to serve the Republic, though he knew that one day he would be forced to reveal his true allegiance.''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' As one of the best and bravest of the Senate Guards, Argyus was chosen to become a Senate Commando. [[File:Argyus_Departure.png|thumb|right|250px|Argyus and his men pursue Dannl Faytonni and Achk Med-Beq through the Senate District.]] Normally stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he was present alongside [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] when the Chancellor met with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to discuss the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] potential peace treaty with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] in the [[22 BBY/Legends|first year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Just prior to a diplomatic [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|mission]] Amidala undertook to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], Argyus led a team of Senate Commandos in pursuit of the [[Con artist/Legends|con men]] [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]] and [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]] through the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], on Coruscant. The two escaped the Senate Commandos and managed to steal Amidala's [[J-type star skiff]] from the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. Faytonni and Med-Beq planned to flee the planet in the [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubian]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], but the [[Skiff/Legends|skiff's]] [[Autopilot/Legends|autopilot]] was set to return the craft to the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Senate docking platform]].''[[The Clone Wars: Departure]]'' During their [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|mission to Rodia]], Amidala and Binks captured the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] and an enemy of the Republic.{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}} The Supreme Chancellor dispatched Argyus—one of his best men for the job''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''—and two other Senate Commandos to oversee the transfer of Gunray into Republic custody on Rodia, and, along with additional commandos, guard the captive viceroy while he was aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']] en route to Coruscant. ===Traitor=== {{Quote|Count Dooku has paid me a fortune to deliver your slimy carcass, so please try to stay alive.|Faro Argyus, to Nute Gunray|audio=ArgyusTryToStayAlive.flac|}} [[File:Argyus_vs_Gree.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Argyus attacks Gree.]] Argyus had been contacted by Count Dooku and bribed into releasing the viceroy and returning him safely to [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]], having been offered enough [[Currency/Legends|money]] to buy a planet or a large [[Moon/Legends|moon]].{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness|d=y}} Not wanting to be forever bound to Republic guardsmen duty, Argyus secretly changed allegiances. During the ''Tranquility''{{'s}} journey, the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] came [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|under attack]] by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] and three [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]], which pierced the hull of the ''Tranquility'', releasing a Separatist boarding party. Eventually, [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under the leadership of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] destroyed the invading [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], but they had only been a distraction to allow Separatist [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] to infiltrate and cripple the Republic warship. Ventress briefly rescued Gunray in the detention level, despite Argyus's conveyed attempt to prevent it. Ventress [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] Argyus out of her way, intent on departing with the viceroy. The arrival of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] thwarted Gunray's escape, however, and forced Ventress to flee. Unduli pursued Ventress into the engine room of the ''Tranquility'', leaving [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to guard the captive viceroy alongside Argyus, his commandos, and Gree. Tano was faced with the decision of obeying orders to stay in the detention level or going with Unduli to fight Ventress. Argyus told the Padawan that following one's heart made them distinct from [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. At his urging, Tano went off to find Ventress, leaving Gunray under the watch of Argyus, his men, and Gree. In the course of her engagement with the Jedi, Ventress sent an all-clear signal to Argyus. His true loyalties revealed to the Republic, Argyus killed his fellow commandos, released Gunray, and took the Neimoidian viceroy as a living shield. Only Gree stood in his way, and, after a short standoff, Gree shot the [[DC-15S/Legends|blaster]] Argyus was holding out of his hand, before Argyus likewise kicked the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] out of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone's]] hands. During the lull in the action that followed, Argyus revealed to the clone commander the reasons behind his treachery—he had no desire to live the rest of his life as an unappreciated guardsmen condemned to life-long servitude to the Republic. Although he did not expect a clone like Gree to understand his disillusionment with the Republic, Argyus continued to defend his betrayal with his belief that a good soldier always did what he believed to be right. He dove for Gree's blaster on the ground, but the clone prevented Argyus from retrieving it. Gree delivered a blow to Argyus's head, knocking him down, but before Gree could kill the traitor, Gunray hit the clone over the head with the butt of Argyus's blaster, knocking him unconscious. ===Escape and death=== [[File:Argyus_death.png|thumb|left|200px|Argyus is killed by Asajj Ventress.]] {{Quote|As successful a rescue as one could hope for, Viceroy. I'll be a legend for this.''"
"''I always had a good feeling about you, Captain.|Faro Argyus and Nute Gunray|audio=ArgyusBoasting.flac|}} When Argyus rose, he signaled Ventress to inform her of his success. Ventress then fled the engine room after detonating leftover explosives. Argyus and Gunray made it to a docked [[Unidentified Consular-class cruiser (Rodia)/Legends|''Consular''-class frigate]], which they used to make their escape. Ventress, meanwhile, eluded the two Jedi and entered an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], arriving aboard the escaping [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|cruiser]] before reaching Separatist space. Argyus arrogantly gloated to Ventress about ''his'' mission's success, and that ''he'' had been responsible for Gunray's rescue. Ventress silenced his gloating permanently, [[Shiak|impaling]] him through the heart''[[The Clone Wars: Ambush]]'' with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Argyus's betrayal shocked the Republic, and proved that even the best and bravest could be corrupted. The fact that he had come from a family noted for its loyalty and service in the Senate Guard did not help this belief. To some, Argyus's defection served as further proof that the Republic was falling apart. ==Personality and traits== [[File:Argyus_boastful.png|thumb|right|220px|Argyus boasts to Nute Gunray during their escape.]] {{Quote|You see, assassin, our plan went off without a hitch.''"
"''Our plan?''"
"''And I will, of course, make sure your contributions are noted in my report to Count Dooku.|Faro Argyus and Asajj Ventress|audio=ArgyusArrogant.flac|}} Captain Argyus was, like all other Senate Commandos, an elite member of the Senate Guard, chosen from the best and bravest of the guards. As such, he was trained for both unarmed and armed combat. He possessed knowledge of both Senate traditions and military tactics. However, Dooku easily bribed Argyus into becoming a traitor, for Argyus didn't want to live in a state of permanent servitude to the Republic. In the end, the captain had sold his honor to Dooku and the Confederacy. He was arrogant and boastful in his skills, evident when he took all the credit for Nute Gunray's rescue from the ''Tranquility''. His boasting led to his [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of Asajj Ventress. ==Equipment== As a captain, he bore the symbol of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on the left shoulder pad of his Senate Commando [[Armor/Legends|armor]],{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode009.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cloak of Darkness}} which was a modified version of [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] with over-sized,{{SW|url=video/cloak-of-darkness-episode-featurette|text="Cloak of Darkness" Episode Featurette}} blaster-proof shoulder pads. Argyus wore the traditional helmet of the Senate Guard, which boasted a ceremonial crest. ==Behind the scenes== Argyus first appeared in the online comic ''[[The Clone Wars: Agenda]]'', a preview to [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] episode "[[Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence'']]." He went on to appear in the comics [[The Clone Wars: Departure|''Departure'']] (the preview for "[[Bombad Jedi]]") and [[The Clone Wars: Transfer|''Transfer'']] (the preview for "[[Cloak of Darkness]]"). Argyus was given the first name "Faro" in [[2009]]'s [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'']]. He was included as an unlockable character in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]] and [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] versions of ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', released in [[2011]]. [[File:ArgyusTCWCampaignGuide.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Captain Argyus]] In his only television appearance, "Cloak of Darkness," Argyus was voiced by [[James Marsters]], who gave the character a "stuffy accent" because he wanted to portray the character as arrogant.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20081205.html|text=James Marsters Talks ''Clone Wars''}} Argyus, along with the rest of the Senate Commandos, was not made a clone because the Senate Commandos were elite Republic guards, essentially predecessors to the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]].
